contract: Only mapping from threadgroup ID to output tile changes. Loads, arithmetic tree and allocation lengths are unchanged within each storage family. Block/both include fresh GPU packing every iteration, R=1. Preallocated buffers; allocation/uploads/loading excluded. Every final output cell, guard, packed word/padding and original input is checked after every warmup/round. Screening uses two randomized processes; confirmation uses mirrored paired ABBA/BAAB blocks and equal 20ms-calibrated batches. Exact dyadic diagnostics, not complete managed throughput or full nonfinite/safety qualification.
